FIELDS.NAME: Home Essentials Hardware
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Home Essentials Hardware operates as a retail hardware store offering a wide range of products including tools, paint, garden supplies, and home improvement materials. Our primary focus is on providing quality merchandise to both DIY enthusiasts and professional contractors. We emphasize a strong commitment to safety and environmental compliance, ensuring all products are well-labeled and stored in accordance with applicable regulations. Additionally, we maintain a comprehensive inventory management system to minimize shrinkage and enhance customer satisfaction. Our store conducts regular audits and employee training sessions to uphold safety protocols, and we actively participate in community engagement through workshops and demonstrations to foster customer loyalty and education. Our strong vendor relationships further ensure our operations are sustainable and efficient, promoting a safe shopping experience for our customers.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: Loss dates: 05/15/2023; Cause: Theft of outdoor inventory due to insufficient security measures; Amount: $1,000; Status: Resolved.
FIELDS.Combined Single Limit: $1,000,000 Combined Single Limit with a $1,000 deductible
FIELDS.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Heavy-duty fire safe, UL Class 350, Grade 1, labeled for fire and water protection.
FIELDS.OTHER PROTECTION: Security patrol services and reinforced fencing to protect the outdoor inventory.
FIELDS.personal property valuation type: Replacement cost valuation for personal property.

FIELDS.G10: Are you involved in manufacturing,: No – Home Essentials Hardware is not involved in manufacturing, mixing, relabeling, or repackaging of products; we focus solely on retail operations. Our commitment is to provide quality merchandise while adhering to all applicable regulations.
